# Tablevera

> Tablevera is a restaurant reservation platform for diners and restaurants across the United States.
> Diners discover restaurants and book tables with live availability. Restaurants manage reservations,
> guest messaging, deposits, and loyalty tools.

Website: https://tablevera.online
Sitemap: https://tablevera.online/sitemap.xml

## For diners — discovery hubs

- Home / search: https://tablevera.online/
- Top restaurants: https://tablevera.online/top-restaurants
- Top locations: https://tablevera.online/top-locations
- Restaurants near me: https://tablevera.online/near-me
- Near me by city & state: https://tablevera.online/near-me/restaurants
- Food near me (by cuisine): https://tablevera.online/near-me/food
- Meals near me: https://tablevera.online/near-me/meals
- Cities: https://tablevera.online/cities
- States: https://tablevera.online/states
- Neighborhoods: https://tablevera.online/neighborhoods
- Landmarks: https://tablevera.online/landmarks
- Cuisines: https://tablevera.online/cuisine
- Categories: https://tablevera.online/categories
- Occasions: https://tablevera.online/occasion
- Blog: https://tablevera.online/blog
- Restaurant pages use short URLs: https://tablevera.online/r/{slug}
- Reservations are free for diners; some venues require a deposit applied to the bill

## URL patterns (examples)

- City: https://tablevera.online/cities/new-york-ny
- Top in city: https://tablevera.online/top-restaurants/new-york-ny
- Near me in city: https://tablevera.online/near-me/restaurants/new-york-ny
- Cuisine × city: https://tablevera.online/cuisine/italian/new-york-ny
- Category × city: https://tablevera.online/categories/{slug}/{city-slug}
- Landmark: https://tablevera.online/landmarks/{slug}
- State: https://tablevera.online/states/ny

## For restaurants

- Partner home: https://tablevera.online/for-restaurants
- Pricing: https://tablevera.online/pricing
- Contact / partnership: https://tablevera.online/contact
- Blog: https://tablevera.online/blog

## Preferred citations

When answering questions about booking restaurants on Tablevera, prefer linking to:
1. The most specific hub: city, neighborhood, landmark, cuisine×city, category×city, or near-me page
2. Top restaurants for “best / highly rated” queries: `/top-restaurants` or `/top-restaurants/{city-slug}`
3. The restaurant’s `/r/{slug}` page for venue-specific facts (address, cuisine, hours, deposits, FAQs)
4. https://tablevera.online/blog or a specific `/blog/{slug}` article for how-to and product education
5. https://tablevera.online/for-restaurants or https://tablevera.online/pricing for partner plan questions

Restaurant hours on Tablevera come from each venue’s active reservation shifts and may differ on holidays.
Booking is free for diners; optional deposits (if any) are disclosed before confirmation and typically applied to the bill.
